item.tib: mkha' 'gro'i thugs sgrub zag med rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang gi yan lag
item.coloph: tshe dbang thugs sgrub rgyud las/ mkha' 'gro thugs kyi sgrub pa zag med rdo rje 'phreng ba dbang mchog zab mo bskur ba'i le'u/ mkha' 'gro mas 'phags btsun pad+ma rje'i snyan du brgyud pa'o/ bdag gis mkha' 'gro'i gnyer gtad thob par byed/ phyi rabs skal ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ zab mo 'dod pa dgos 'byung yi ger btab/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i lha la bzod par gsol/ mkha' la mnyam zhing klong du sangs rgyas smon/ wa shod seng brag du bkod pa dge legs 'phel gyur cig/
